prompt: In a crisp anime style, the scene unfolds at a high-altitude mountain campsite surrounded by jagged grey peaks. On the left, a woman in a blue beanie sits cross-legged on a folded tarp, her posture relaxed as she warms her hands over a small fire. Next to her, a black kettle boils vigorously, steam rising in thick white curls against the cool air. In the center, a man with a thick beard stands holding a wooden ladle, stirring the contents of a large iron pot with deliberate care. He looks toward the right side of the frame where a young girl in a yellow raincoat points excitedly at the sky. Her finger directs attention to a soaring eagle with wide brown wings gliding above the tree line. Beside the girl, a golden retriever sits patiently, its tongue lolling out in a happy pant while it watches the bird. The final entity is a green backpack resting on a flat rock near the fire, slightly worn from travel. There is no tent visible in the background, leaving the group exposed to the vast open sky. The woman in the blue beanie interacts with the black kettle by sitting next to it, creating a sense of domestic warmth amidst the wild surroundings. The man with the thick beard interacts with the young girl in the yellow raincoat by looking at her, acknowledging her discovery of the eagle. The golden retriever remains close to the girl, providing companionship. The green backpack serves as a static anchor in the foreground, contrasting with the dynamic movement of the eagle and the steam. The composition balances human activity with natural grandeur, emphasizing the scale of the mountains against the small group.
